about_the_game:
Once upon a time, there was a young man named Josh.

His life has been marked by hardship. Between an exhausting routine and the daily struggle to support his mother, Josh does his best to move forward — even after the mysterious disappearance of his brother, with whom he had always been very close. With a heavy heart, he faces yet another day… but something is about to change.

On a hectic morning, he wakes up late, gets scolded by his boss, reads some troubling news, and finds a cryptic note from his mother. In the midst of all this, his phone rings: it’s his mother, asking for help. Now, you must decide:

Will you answer your mother’s request, or fulfill your duty at work?

Every choice has consequences.

WARN is a narrative-driven game with multiple endings, where your decisions shape Josh’s fate.

Explore the tension between duty and affection as you experience the inner conflicts of a young man on the edge. In WARN, there are no easy decisions — and every path may uncover unexpected truths.

Features:

  • Interactive visual novel focused on storytelling

  • Meaningful choices: Two main story paths with distinct endings

  • Original, emotional narrative: Focused on themes such as family, loss, and responsibility

  • Detailed urban environments: Reflecting the weight of the protagonist’s decisions

  • Immersive soundtrack: Matching the mood of each scene

  • Estimated playtime: 30 to 60 minutes, depending on your choices

  • Language: Portuguese, Italian, English and Spanish

Are you ready to face the consequences of your choices?

Find out how far Josh is willing to go — and what he’s prepared to sacrifice.
